name: whaapp-dev
description: Dev-only tooling: local Firebase emulators and database rules tests. Never shipped; the site itself has no build step.

scripts.test:rules: node build-rules.mjs && export PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH && firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-whaapp --config ../firebase.test.json "node --test rules.test.mjs"
